i.norm: Verifies that parseFromLocalFileData reads the flags byte from the given offset. The flags byte is the first byte of the parsed region, so with an offset of 2 the flags are taken from index 2 of the data array. That byte is set to the ACCESS_TIME_BIT value (2), so getFlags() should return 2.
The flags byte lives at the offset; set index 2 to the access-time flag.
